candidates.summary: search_for_target's mover loop: (1) the prefilter runs with X = mover - 1 so its end test is the DEX's own Z flag (DEX/BEQ, 4 cycles) instead of DEX/CPX #2/BCC (6) on each of the ~20 passed-over movers a pass, mover 1 branching to an INX in front of the full check; (2) set_cm_left is inlined with its two results stored straight into the left test's CMP #/SBC # operands (saves the JSR/RTS and 4 cycles on each of ~4 left tests a pass); (3) the entry search_for_target_loop is just BEQ (every way there is right after a DEX), 2 bytes and 2 cycles less; (4) the loop is put on a page boundary (never-run pad in front of it) so none of its hot branches crosses a page (the old loop had the BPL back, the BCC to the full check and the skip BCC crossing &27xx/&28xx). Wrapped in IF SKY_MODE: the SKY_MODE=0 builds (the DEBUG_FULLREDRAW oracle, SKY_HELI=0) keep the original code, since they have only 9 bytes free in the main block and this grows it by 28. Measured on the bench build (pcprof, 2026-10-22): work a pass seed 1 34457 -> 34381 (logic 9440 -> 9349), RIGHT 39690 -> 39594 (logic 10255 -> 10155). passlock seed 1 3000 passes and seed 3 2000 passes with screen, oracle (DEBUG_FULLREDRAW) seed 5 2500 passes with screen, and helilock flight 5: identical. Best of three (the others overlap it: alternatives).
candidates.equivalence: The prefilter visits the same movers in the same order with the same tests: mover X (11 down to 2) is passed over by the same right-of-range and left-of-range comparisons on the same data, and movers 1 and 0 are always checked in full. Biased index: inside the prefilter X holds (mover - 1) and every table read is base + 1,X, so the DEX/BEQ pair does the work of DEX/CPX #2/BCC: X reaches 0 exactly when the next mover is 1, and the BEQ target INX restores X = 1 for the full check. A mover that passes the prefilter reaches the JSR through INX, so check_for_mover_collision_with_mover_X, the BCS and consider_next_enemy see X = the mover as before. A at each JSR is the same: the same LDA/CMP/LDA/SBC sequence leaves it (INX/DEX/BEQ do not touch A or C), and Y is never touched. Left bound: the inlined set_cm_left is the same instruction sequence (LDA mover_x_low, SEC, SBC #MOVER_WIDEST, low byte; LDA &C5; no borrow keeps &C5; a borrow does SBC #0, and INC A when that borrows again: &FF -> 0, low byte 0) with the stores going to the CMP #/SBC # operand bytes instead of cm_left_low/cm_left_high; the borrow case is moved out of line behind the BRA and rejoins with the same A. The left test then compares with the same two bytes. Nothing else reads cm_left_low/cm_left_high after search_for_target without first calling set_cm_left (grep: the range loop at 3532 and the friends loop at 3967 each call it before reading; the tools do not read them). Entry: search_for_target_loop is entered only by consider_next_enemy's DEX/BPL and found_target_2b1f's DEX/BPL (grep search_for_target_loop: lines 4047 and 4079 only), both right after a DEX with X >= 0, so Z = 1 iff X = 0 (the full check of mover 0); X = 1 goes through the prefilter's DEX to X = 0 and the BEQ to INX, a full check of mover 1; X >= 2 tests mover X. The first entry from the setup is LDX #&0A / BRA into the first test (mover 11). Exit: search_done unchanged (reached by fall-through when the BPL is not taken). The V flag is set by the same SBC/ADC operands as before. The IF SKY_MODE ELSE branch is the original text, so the SKY_MODE=0 builds are byte-for-byte what they were.
candidates.relies_on: Page crossings: after the change the loop (BEQ entry, DEX/BEQ head, tests, INX, JSR, BCS, DEX, BPL: &2800-&2829 in the bench build) lies wholly in page &28; the old code's crossing taken branches (BPL back, BCC to search_in_full, the skip BCC at the left test, each +1 cycle: about 10 a pass) are gone, and the move of everything after search_done by 28 bytes is inside the measured totals. Needs the pad in front of the loop: IF LO(*) >= &E0 / SKIP &100 - LO(*) puts the loop on the next page boundary when the code before it ends in the last &20 bytes of a page (it ends at &27FB in the bench, ship and release builds: pad 5); if earlier edits move that code the loop stays aligned or, outside the last &20 bytes, merely unaligned (slower, still correct). Branch range: search_done must stay within 128 bytes of check_if_friendly for the BPL right after it (line 4049 + 1): with the loop at &2800 it is exactly -128 (BPL at &282C -> &27AE); no more bytes can be added to the window. Room: +28 bytes in the main block (SKY_MODE=1 only; 193 free before, 165 after); the IF SKY_MODE wrapper keeps the DEBUG_FULLREDRAW and SKY_HELI=0 builds as they were. Assembled in bench, full, ship, release, gameplay, SKY_HELI=0 and SKY_HELI=2. Self-modifying operands: stf_left_low_operand_ve / stf_left_high_operand_ve are the CMP #/SBC # operands written at the start of each search (main RAM below &3000, the way stf_x_max_high_operand_s already is). No JSR name+N or other entries past a changed label (grep search_for_target_loop, search_prefilter_next, search_in_full, stf_left_test_s, consider_next_enemy: only inside this region and the two DEX/BPLs above). New labels carry the _ve suffix.
